publishing house: The publishing house plans to bring out ten new books next year.
这家出版社计划明年推出十本新书。
have difficulty (in) doing sth: Many students have difficulty in understanding long passages without a dictionary.
许多学生在没有词典的情况下理解长篇文章有困难。
manners: Good manners cost nothing but can win you respect everywhere.
礼貌不花分文,却能在任何地方为你赢得尊重。
wait in line: We had to wait in line for almost an hour to buy the tickets.
我们买票不得不排了近一个小时的队。
on time: The train arrived on time despite the heavy rain last night.
尽管昨夜大雨,火车还是准时到达。
feel at home: The warm welcome from the local family made us feel at home.
当地家庭的热情欢迎让我们感到宾至如归。
politeness: Politeness costs nothing, but it means a lot to the people around you.
礼貌不花分文,却对身边的人意义重大。
when it comes to (doing) sth: When it comes to cooking, my father is far better than my mother.
说到做饭,我父亲比我母亲强得多。
get used to sth: It took me a month to get used to the cold weather here.
我花了一个月才习惯这里寒冷的天气。
all at once: The three bells rang all at once, filling the square with sound.
三口钟同时敲响,钟声响彻广场。
jump the line: It is rude to jump the line when others have been waiting for long.
别人排了那么久的队,你却插队,这是不礼貌的。
cool off: Drink some cold water to cool off after running on such a hot day.
大热天跑完步后,喝点凉水凉快凉快。
in case: Take an umbrella with you in case it rains on the way home.
带把伞吧,以防回家路上下雨。
in one's way: A big box stood in my way, so I had to move it aside first.
一个大箱子挡着我的路,我只好先把它挪开。
keep one's word: If you keep your word, people will learn to trust you.
如果你信守诺言,人们会学着信任你。
respectfully: The students stood up and respectfully greeted the old teacher at the door.
学生们站起来,在门口毕恭毕敬地迎接老教师。
earphones: Remember to take your earphones out before the exam begins.
考试开始前,记得把耳机摘下来。
be about to do sth: I was about to leave home when the phone rang suddenly.
我正要出门,电话突然响了。
remind sb to do sth: My mother always reminds me to take my keys before leaving the house.
妈妈总是提醒我出门前带上钥匙。
seat belt: Fasten your seat belt before the plane takes off.
飞机起飞前请系好安全带。
north-western: The north-western part of the country is famous for its grasslands.
这个国家的西北部以草原闻名。
north-eastern: Many tourists visit the north-eastern coast in summer to enjoy the cool sea wind.
许多游客夏天去东北部的海岸享受凉爽的海风。
go to hospital: He had to go to hospital because the cut on his arm was deep.
他手臂上的伤口很深,不得不去医院看病。
on board: Everyone on board was excited when the ship finally left the harbor.
当船终于驶离港口时,船上的人都激动不已。
eye care: Good eye care habits, such as resting your eyes often, protect your sight.
良好的眼睛保健习惯,比如经常让眼睛休息,能保护视力。
operate on: The doctors decided to operate on his leg at once to save it.
医生们决定立即对他的腿做手术,以便保住它。
carry on with: After a short rest, the workers carried on with their work.
短暂休息后,工人们继续干活。
in addition (to): In addition to English, she is also learning French and Japanese.
除了英语,她还在学法语和日语。
healthcare: The government has spent more money on healthcare for old people this year.
政府今年在老年人医疗服务上投入了更多资金。
miss out on: Don't miss out on the fun—come to the party with us tonight.
别错过乐趣——今晚跟我们一起去参加聚会吧。
unclean: Wash your hands before dinner, because unclean hands may carry germs.
饭前要洗手,因为不干净的手可能携带细菌。
separate ... into: The teacher separated the class into four groups for the game.
老师把全班分成四组做游戏。
successfully: The team successfully finished the difficult task before the deadline.
团队在截止日期前成功地完成了这项艰巨的任务。
run out: Our food will run out soon, so we need to buy some more.
我们的食物快用完了,需要再买一些。
coughing: His coughing kept the whole family awake all night.
他的咳嗽声让全家人一夜没睡好。
single-use: Many countries are trying to reduce single-use plastic bags and cups.
许多国家正在努力减少一次性塑料袋和塑料杯的使用。
solar power: This village uses solar power to light the streets at night.
这个村庄利用太阳能在夜间为街道照明。
second-hand: He bought a second-hand bicycle, which works just as well as a new one.
他买了一辆二手自行车,用起来和新的一样好。
organized: An organized person always knows where to find the things he needs.
有条理的人总是知道自己需要的东西放在哪里。
keep ... in (good) order: Please keep your books in good order on the shelf after reading.
读完书后,请把书在书架上摆放整齐。
